messages.text: Could you add a little pavement chalkboard outside the café in this pic? I’ve been thinking it would be nice to see how the café looks with a sign out front. What I want it to say is “COFFEE TO GO”, and please keep the wide shot and everything else as it is. My only worry is that an added sign might look pasted on and distract from the place itself. Please make the chalkboard look like it’s really standing there, not like a caption on the photo.
